caption:
The AI podcast of the Epstein files is trending on Spotify right now. Built with Claude Code + ElevenLabs, I used the same setup to turn the 1100-page Ram Mandir Supreme Court judgement into a 6-episode podcast series. 

Live on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/1rTFkrGr8otslLT44muYK1

Here’s the wild part:
→ Fed the entire 1100-page PDF to Claude Code 
→ One prompt: “break this into 7 episodes, write narration scripts” 
→ It read every page, found the key turning points, wrote the scripts 
→ Fed scripts into ElevenLabs 
→ AI narrator voice 
→ Uploaded to Spotify for Creators 
→ published

Total time: a few minutes. Total cost: less than $30. A production team would charge you thousands.

The craziest part? This works with ANY document.
Books. Research papers. Government reports. Legal filings. Whitepapers. Historical documents. Technical docs.

I made a complete step-by-step guide with the exact prompt, the ElevenLabs workflow, and how to publish on Spotify from scratch.

Comment “PODCAST” and I’ll send it to you.
